title: forge vuln patch document (forge.dev/vuln-patch/v1)
description: What `forge vuln patch --json` did to each requested finding — bumped, verified, fixed, still present, or skipped for an agent with the reason — and the exit code it chose. Generated from the Go type forge encodes it with.

env.description: Env is the env whose findings were patched; "" for a directory scan.

release.description: Release is the release the findings were read from; "" for a directory scan.

dir.description: Dir is the tree that was patched.

changed.description: Changed reports that the patcher changed the tree.

findings.description: Findings are the requested findings and what happened to each.

bumps.description: Bumps are the version changes applied, one per package per manifest.

verify.description: Verify is the verification run; absent without --verify.

pr.description: PR is the pull request --pr opened; absent without --pr.

exit_code.description: ExitCode is the exit code the command returned: 0 every requested finding bumped (and verified with --verify); 1 a bump failed or verification failed — the agent takeover signal; 2 nothing deterministic left to do for at least one requested finding (skipped); 4 refused.

refusals.description: Refusals are why the patch was refused (exit 4): nothing was changed.

notes.description: Notes are what the reader should know that changed no status.

Bump.description: Bump is one package raised in one manifest.

ecosystem.description: Ecosystem is the tool that applied it.

manifest.description: Manifest is the go.mod, lockfile or Dockerfile, relative to the patched tree.

package.description: Package is the module or package name; "toolchain" for a go.mod's toolchain directive, and the image (alpine, golang) for a Dockerfile's FROM.

from.description: From and To are the versions before and after; for a Dockerfile, the image references.

direct.description: Direct reports a direct dependency; a transitive npm, pnpm or yarn one is raised by an override (overrides, pnpm.overrides, resolutions).

commands.description: Commands are the commands run for its manifest, each as argv (every bump of one manifest shares them).

edits.description: Edits are the changes the patcher made to a file itself rather than through a tool: an override in package.json, a Dockerfile's FROM.

error.description: Error is the failure, with the tool's output tail; "" on success.

branch.description: Branch is the branch the patch is committed on.

committed.description: Committed reports the commit; false when there was nothing to commit or verification failed (the changes stay on Branch, uncommitted).

url.description: URL is the opened pull request.

Package.description: Package is the component a finding is in.

name.description: Name and Version as the SBOM names them.

purl.description: PURL is the package URL, when the SBOM gives one.

type.description: Type is the ecosystem: go-module, npm, apk, deb, python, binary, ...

Result.description: Result is one finding and what happened to it.

id.description: ID is the advisory (CVE-…, GHSA-…, GO-…), and Aliases its other ids.

package.description: Package is the vulnerable package as the scan named it.

ecosystem.description: Ecosystem is the patcher that handled it; "" when none applies.

installed.description: Installed is the version the finding names, and Target the version it is bumped to ("" when skipped before a target was chosen). For an OS package, Target is the base image reference its Dockerfile is refreshed to.

manifests.description: Manifests are the tree's files the package resolved to, relative to Dir (go.mod, package-lock.json, Dockerfile, ...).

status.description: Status is fixed, still_present, bumped, failed or skipped.

reason.description: Reason says why it was skipped, failed or is still present.

VerifyResult.description: VerifyResult is the verification of a patch.

command.description: Command is the verify command (sh -c), "" when the project has none and only the rescan ran.

source.description: Source says where Command came from: flag, forge.yaml, taskfile, go, npm, pnpm, yarn, or none.

passed.description: Passed reports that Command exited 0 (true when there is none).

output.description: Output is the tail of Command's combined output.

rescanned.description: Rescanned are the directories rescanned, relative to the tree.

rebuilt.description: Rebuilt are the Dockerfiles changed, rebuilt with docker and whose images were rescanned, relative to the tree.

rescan_error.description: RescanError is why the rescan could not run, when it could not.
